# kguardian image admission policy for the cluster
# Kyverno ImageValidatingPolicy, validationActions [Audit] (failures go to policy reports)
# Generated from the signers kguardian verified on running images. kguardian never applies
# anything: review, commit and apply it yourself.
# REVIEW EVERY IDENTITY BEFORE APPLYING: identities were observed on running images, not vetted.
# A signer that signed an image you run is trusted by this policy for every image it covers.
# identity: keyless issuer=https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com subjectRegExp=^https://github\.com/example-org/checkout/\.github/workflows/release\.yaml@refs/tags/.+$ (widened from observed tag subjects)
#   verified ghcr.io/example/checkout@sha256:f48949f11f15c0e2b8fa2132d1ab201cf50e80dea612783e5c3ac78c6b378235
# identity: key sha256:d4d97426189ec7a3bc8a16cc81bfc8ec314b179c4dad1123ff4e167026fc2c41
#   verified ghcr.io/example/ledger@sha256:f57d4908af0027fb38feb4e8d5a8d5e2c1511ccf52c596837d2314611f1640fe
# not covered: docker.io/grafana/grafana (a running digest is key_signed)
# not covered: ghcr.io/example/reports (a running digest is unsigned)
# not covered: ghcr.io/fluxcd/source-controller (a running digest is unknown)
# not covered: quay.io/prometheus/node-exporter (a running digest is unknown)
# not covered: quay.io/prometheus/prometheus (a running digest is invalid)
# not covered: registry.k8s.io/ingress-nginx/controller (a running digest has not been checked)
apiVersion: policies.kyverno.io/v1beta1
kind: ImageValidatingPolicy
metadata:
  annotations:
    kguardian.dev/generated-by: kguardian-broker/1.18.2
    kguardian.dev/source: observed verified image signers
  name: kguardian-signed-checkout-0cd14f55
spec:
  attestations:
  - intoto:
      type: https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1
    name: p0
  attestors:
  - cosign:
      keyless:
        identities:
        - issuer: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
          subjectRegExp: ^https://github\.com/example-org/checkout/\.github/workflows/release\.yaml@refs/tags/.+$
    name: a0
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:
      - ''
      apiVersions:
      - v1
      operations:
      - CREATE
      - UPDATE
      resources:
      - pods
  matchImageReferences:
  - glob: ghcr.io/example/checkout
  - glob: ghcr.io/example/checkout:*
  - glob: ghcr.io/example/checkout@*
  validationActions:
  - Audit
  validationConfigurations:
    mutateDigest: false
    verifyDigest: false
  validations:
  - expression: '!has(images.containers) || images.containers.map(image, verifyImageSignatures(image, [attestors.a0])).all(e, e > 0)'
    message: 'containers: image is not signed by a signer kguardian observed for it'
  - expression: '!has(images.initContainers) || images.initContainers.map(image, verifyImageSignatures(image, [attestors.a0])).all(e, e > 0)'
    message: 'initContainers: image is not signed by a signer kguardian observed for it'
  - expression: '!has(images.ephemeralContainers) || images.ephemeralContainers.map(image, verifyImageSignatures(image, [attestors.a0])).all(e, e > 0)'
    message: 'ephemeralContainers: image is not signed by a signer kguardian observed for it'
  - expression: '!has(images.containers) || images.containers.map(image, verifyAttestationSignatures(image, attestations.p0, [attestors.a0])).all(e, e > 0)'
    message: 'containers: required attestation https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 is missing or not signed by an observed signer'
  - expression: '!has(images.initContainers) || images.initContainers.map(image, verifyAttestationSignatures(image, attestations.p0, [attestors.a0])).all(e, e > 0)'
    message: 'initContainers: required attestation https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 is missing or not signed by an observed signer'
  - expression: '!has(images.ephemeralContainers) || images.ephemeralContainers.map(image, verifyAttestationSignatures(image, attestations.p0, [attestors.a0])).all(e, e > 0)'
    message: 'ephemeralContainers: required attestation https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1 is missing or not signed by an observed signer'
